title: Top Picks at a Glance (Fast Navigator)
use_cases: Use when building lead capture or demo request workflows inside Notion
Implement when creating qualification assessments and quote request forms
Configure when automating client onboarding or service intake processes
Use when tracking support requests, bug reports, and IT incidents
Implement when collecting product feedback or conducting post-event evaluations
content:
This isn’t a “best tools” list. It’s a best-use-case list—the form types we see drive real outcomes in teams using Notion databases.

#### 5 high-impact form categories (with examples inside)

1) Lead capture & sales (contact, demo request, referral)

2) Qualification & estimation (quote request, audit/assessment, product finder)

3) Onboarding & intake (client onboarding, service intake, application flows)

4) Support & operations (support request, bug report, IT request, incident report)

5) Research & feedback (product feedback, NPS/CSAT, post-event evaluation)

If you want to build these as Notion-connected forms, NoteForms is built for that: submissions write directly into your Notion database, with extra field types and workflow controls beyond Notion’s native forms.
